symbols.name: VIDEO_REFRESH_RATE_HZ
symbols.initialization: System_InitializeRuntime writes 0x32, or 0x3C when VDP status bit 0 is clear
symbols.consumer: Scene_EnterTransitionMode compares against 0x32 to select the transition presentation row

symbols.name: SCENE_SCRIPT_WAIT
symbols.consumer: SceneScript_AdvanceState at 0x001A8EAE when the scene-script record type is 2

symbols.name: MENU_OPTIONS_INITIAL_PRESENTATION_LATCH
symbols.consumer: Menu_RunOptionsPresentationContinuation at 0x001B3DBC before transition audio command 0x1A

limitations: SCENE_SCRIPT_WAIT has one direct writer in the exported code; its startup zeroing is implicit in the reset/runtime initialization path.
MENU_OPTIONS_INITIAL_PRESENTATION_LATCH is a one-shot presentation/audio gate; no higher-level menu-state meaning is claimed.
VIDEO_REFRESH_RATE_HZ retains STARTUP_FRAME_LIMIT as a compatibility alias for older target manifests.
conclusion: The direct scene-script, video-timing, and options-presentation RAM contracts now have canonical identities backed by exact writer/reader instruction pairs.
